name: optical_point_frontend_then_roof_review
purpose: Close one executable input-to-product path before comparing alternative image-fusion positions.

inputs.optical: NAIP raster with verified band names and acquisition date; RGB, optionally NIR
inputs.elevation: 3DEP original LiDAR points plus ground reference, not bare-earth DEM alone
inputs.footprint: USBF/OSM/GBA or another declared footprint source, shared across future comparisons
inputs.metadata: CRS, horizontal/vertical units, acquisition dates or unknown, registration provenance

stages.operation: Pair and align existing observations; bind files, coordinates and original point indices.
Use optical and point evidence before the first reconstruction; retain uncertain observations.
stages.minimum_implementation: Reuse frozen source-trained point, optical and fusion MLPs; no new large training. R/G/NIR descriptors are the existing optical features; Blue is not read by these weights.

stages.operation: Reconstruct initial roof planes and a building shell using fixed Roofer settings.
Associate original observations and DL evidence with reconstructed roof components; decide retain, conservative trim, or unresolved.
stages.minimum_implementation: Reuse semantic probabilities to audit roof support; deterministic aggregation and source-calibrated point thresholds. This is not a newly trained mesh-repair network.

stages.operation: Reconstruct after accepted trims, retain native vertical walls and footprint holes, and check shell boundary incidence.
stages.minimum_implementation: Native roof/wall/ground extrusion; no unsupported roof bridging or learned full-occlusion completion. Unresolved gaps remain explicit.
stages.closure_semantics: Roof surfaces can be discontinuous in height. The building shell uses vertical connecting walls. Courtyards must not be roof-capped. Edge incidence alone does not certify a valid solid.

stages.operation: Export every requested building, including unchanged, rejected-edit, fallback and failure cases.

invariants: Input original XYZ, footprints and point indices are immutable.
No reference roof mesh or target accuracy metric is read by inference or edit selection.
Production classifications and semantic predictions are not independent roof GT.
A closed shell is not proof of a geometrically correct roof.
Future comparisons change the optical-fusion position while retaining shared inputs and reconstruction settings.
deferred: New RGB/point encoders and learned temporal reliability gates
A dedicated learned structure-editing or completion head
Additional quality-control modules and broad method comparisons

future_two_routes.A: Optical and point evidence before first reconstruction, followed by joint structure review.
future_two_routes.B: Point-driven first reconstruction, followed by optical-assisted structure review.
future_two_routes.status: interfaces reserved; no comparative effectiveness claim in this run; B is not an exact reproduction of Jung and Sohn 2019
